/bin/bash -lc 'set +e
for f in src/worker.js ops/start-worker.js test/smoke.test.js; do node --check "$f"; echo "node --check $f exit=$?"; done
node -e "import('"'./src/worker.js').then(async ({retriesEnabled})=>{ console.log('RETRIES_ENABLED=false =>', retriesEnabled({RETRIES_ENABLED:'false'})); })\"; echo \"retry probe exit="'$?"
timeout 3s node ops/start-worker.js; echo "start-worker exit=$?"
npm audit --omit=dev; echo "npm audit exit=$?"
'
